_about: Peak-transformation fragment (List 19 #185) — an ANNEX to #130's mochiichao/forme-change/v1, not a new format or axis. The peak flag and criterion shape are PROPOSED into #130's fragment home (its home disposes). Zero peak forms are instanced; Strikechamp's unsuited forms are explicitly NOT claimed as peak (their criterion is #130's OPEN slot). Eligibility classes ship null — mythical-only exclusivity is a documented pattern, not asserted.

model.classFlag: peak: true on a form inside a species' #130 formFamily; the form is otherwise an ordinary #130 form (deltas are family data, active state is battle-state forme)
model.direction: one-way within the battle, fixed for the class; ends at faint or battle end

entryConditions.item: #130 criterion kind 'held' — the held slot (#31, read via #183/#109's seat) carries the family's named item id
entryConditions.storyFact: a named #12 fact in the family record's requiresFacts[] stands true

model.onePerSide: per battle, per side, at most one individual enters a peak form; the game-lane command is offered only when conditions hold AND the side's peak use is unspent — otherwise absent, legibly (#38 discipline); a spent use never refreshes mid-battle
model.presentation: #42's transformation-sequence grammar (announcement, held pose, fixed-order channels, background divorce, landing) via #9 animscript blocks; #130's E4 identity law holds (silhouette primitive + signature motif persist)
model.reversion: at battle end, always; persistAfterBattle: false BY CLASS LAW for peak forms (a family may not override; ordinary forms keep #130's per-family rule); stored nowhere
